title: Wishlist
content: Implement wishlist/favorites functionality. Add to wishlist: heart icon on product cards and detail pages. Toggle states: outline heart (not saved), filled red heart (saved). Animation: scale bounce on add. Storage: localStorage for guests, API for logged in. Wishlist page: grid of saved products. Card actions: "Add to Cart", "Remove" buttons. Share wishlist option. Empty wishlist: helpful message with shop suggestions.

variants.simple: Add heart icon toggle to save products to wishlist page.
variants.detailed: Implement wishlist/favorites functionality. Add to wishlist: heart icon on product cards and detail pages. Toggle states: outline heart (not saved), filled red heart (saved). Animation: scale bounce on add. Storage: localStorage for guests, API for logged in. Wishlist page: grid of saved products. Card actions: "Add to Cart", "Remove" buttons. Share wishlist option. Empty wishlist: helpful message with shop suggestions.
variants.advanced: Implement wishlist/favorites functionality with comprehensive features. Add to wishlist trigger: heart icon button (Heart from lucide-react) on product cards (absolute top-right) and detail pages (in action buttons). Toggle states: outline stroke (not saved), filled red (fill-red-500) when saved. Animation: scale-125 bounce on add with duration-300, optional confetti or heart particles. Storage strategy: localStorage for guest users (array of product IDs), API endpoint for authenticated users (POST /api/wishlist/add, DELETE /api/wishlist/remove). Sync: merge localStorage wishlist into user account on login. Wishlist page (/wishlist route): grid of saved products using standard product card component (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Card actions overlay or below: "Add to Cart" primary button, "Remove" text button (X icon). Share wishlist: "Share" button generates unique shareable link (/wishlist/share/[id]), copy to clipboard with toast. Move to cart: add to cart and optionally remove from wishlist (toggle setting). Price drop alerts: show badge "Price dropped!" if current price < saved price, show percentage or amount saved. Stock alerts: for out-of-stock items, show "Notify Me" button to get email when back in stock. Empty wishlist state: heart illustration, "Your wishlist is empty" heading, "Save items you love" subtext, "Start Shopping" CTA button. Sort/filter options: date added (newest/oldest), price (low/high), availability (in stock first). Multiple lists feature: create named lists ("Birthday Wishlist", "Home Office"), move items between lists, separate share links per list. List management: rename, delete lists. Guest user limit: cap at 50 items, show "Sign in to save more" prompt. Real-time sync: update heart state across all product cards when toggled. Accessibility: aria-label on heart button indicating state ("Add to wishlist" / "Remove from wishlist").

author: Ersin KOÇ
